title: ARC contracts: move the weekly boundary from UTC to Europe/Moscow
assumptions: Before: recurring orders close Monday 00:00 UTC (03:00 Europe/Moscow). After: they close Monday 00:00 Europe/Moscow, so the last accepting minute is Sunday 23:59 MSK.
Both policies keep an exact seven-day window. Contract prices, targets, player limits, order budgets and the 250000.00 Vault network weekly cap are unchanged.

The live classic audit at 2026-09-12T21:30:08+03:00 reported zero accepted quantity, zero spent/held Vault and the full 250000.00 weekly budget across the current resource orders; there were no pending or manual-review submissions.

Dynamic pricing uses elapsed window time. Moving the current window start three hours earlier can add at most four Vault cents to a 7.50 base unit quote at migration time; the representative after value 7.54 deliberately rounds that bound upward.

Low/base/high model one weekly coal batch of 32/128/512 items per participant as 4.5714285714/18.2857142857/73.1428571429 daily events. The forge coal envelope remains capped at 25000.00 Vault per week.
The quote-time delta is a conservative one-time migration comparison, not a permanent price increase: subsequent weeks use the same seven-day pricing curve relative to the new local boundary.
Premium tokens, item quantities, EconomyShopGUI SELL retirement and all non-contract income sources are unaffected.

flows.basis: Representative upper-bound quote delta caused only by moving the current seven-day window three hours earlier; the 25000.00 order envelope remains unchanged.
